title: Guess Not
technique: Plain written prompt: cast and rooms from reference images, every camera move described in words.
story: At night a shopper adds the Fig & Cedar candle to her cart.
She wonders if it's safe for her cat, but the page never says.
So she closes the tab. Guess not.
Next morning the owner reads the low sales as nobody wanting her favourite candle.
Scout's orb rises from the candle flame: Don't guess. Ask your shoppers.
End screen: Scout interviews your shoppers for you. Get free early access.

shots.what: She clicks Add to cart; the Added to cart notice slides in.
shots.line: Okay. Fig and Cedar. This one.
shots.speaker: Shopper (inner)

shots.what: On the sofa, she glances back at the cat walking behind.
She scrolls the product page, brows tightening.
shots.line: Hmm. Is this one safe for my cat?
shots.speaker: Shopper (inner)

shots.what: Extreme close-up on her eyes, screen glow sliding across.
shots.speaker: Shopper (inner)

shots.what: She clicks; the product page closes to a blank tab.
shots.speaker: Shopper (inner)

shots.what: High flip: camera rolls overhead, lands in the owner's sunlit studio.
At her packing table, turning the lit jar, eyes on laptop.
shots.line: Huh. Thought Fig and Cedar would sell way more.
shots.speaker: Owner

shots.what: She lifts the jar in both hands, glances into the lens.
shots.line: My favourite, too. Guess I'm discontinuing it.
shots.speaker: Owner

shots.what: The jar's three flames merge into Scout's orb, which rises.
The orb hovers by her shoulder; she stops, eyebrows up.
shots.speaker: Scout

shots.what: The orb flies into the lens and becomes the o in Scout.
shots.line: Scout interviews your shoppers for you. Get free early access.
shots.speaker: Scout
